invariants: KEFE computes SHA-256 over the exact bounded HTTP response bytes before parsing.
Provider parsers cannot choose, supply or override content_hash or raw_storage_ref.
The evidence seal is immutable, slotted and repr-redacted.
The in-memory store owns an immutable byte copy and returns owned copies for inspection.
Identical bytes seal idempotently to the same canonical hash and reference.
A digest collision with different bytes fails closed.
The unconfigured store is retryable and does not claim production durability.
Raw body bytes never enter repr, operational results or bounded error text.
The parser receives only the redacted plan, bounded ProviderHttpResponse, trace_id and UTC time.
CapturedSource content_hash and raw_storage_ref come only from a validated evidence seal.
No live external request, concrete provider or durable object-store backend is required or claimed.
